newsitem.title: UK: Stress can triple risk of miscarriage - report.
newsitem.headline: Stress can triple risk of miscarriage - report.

text.p: The stress of working long hours can triple a pregnant woman's risk of miscarrying, New Scientist magazine reported on Thursday.
Epidemiologists from the University of California at Davis questioned 584 female lawyers who graduated from the university's law school about their health and their domestic and professional lives.
They found a clear link between long hours in the office and miscarriage in the first three months of pregnancy, even allowing for factors such as smoking and drinking.
Those who worked more than 45 hours a week were five times more likely to be stressed and three times more likely to have suffered an early miscarriage than those who worked less than 35 hours.
New Scientist said the results of the study would be published in the next edition of the Journal of Occupational and Environmental Medicine.
